bioconda.name: pynxtools-spm
bioconda.summary: A pynxtools reader plugin that converts scanning probe microscopy (SPM) data to NeXus.
bioconda.description:
pynxtools-spm converts STM, STS and AFM data from several vendors into
NeXus/HDF5 files that follow NXstm, NXsts and NXafm.

commands: python -c "from importlib.metadata import entry_points; assert 'spm' in [e.name for e in entry_points(group='pynxtools.reader')]"
